question: Which among the following started “Bharat Jodo Yatra” in September 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Rahul Gandhi.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rahul Gandhi started the "Bharat Jodo Yatra" in September 2022, which was aimed at bringing people together and uniting the country.**
 
• The yatra was aimed at **countering the divisive policies of the ruling government and promoting unity and harmony among all sections of society.**
 
• The yatra covered several states and saw the participation of thousands of people from different walks of life.
 
• Rahul Gandhi's "Bharat Jodo Yatra" received widespread support from the public and was seen as an important step towards national unity and integration.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** ** **Amit Shah** is a senior leader of the ruling Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) and currently serves as the Union Home Minister of India.

 
 
• ​ He has not started any such yatra in September 2022.
 
 
 
• ** Akbaruddin Owaisi** is a leader of the **All India Majlis-e-Ittehadul Muslimeen (AIMIM) **party and a member of the Telangana Legislative Assembly.
 
 
• He has not started any such yatra in September 2022.
 
 
 
• **Arvind Kejriwal** is the Chief Minister of Delhi and the leader of the Aam Aadmi Party (AAP).
 
 
• He has not started any such yatra in September 2022.
